preservationReasons.Tab: Tab is the standard text printed on Czech physical keyboards and the established Czech name for this key.
preservationReasons.Enter: Enter is the standard text printed on Czech physical keyboards and the established Czech name for this key.
preservationReasons.Pause: Pause is the standard text printed on the physical key and is used unchanged in Czech technical UI.
preservationReasons.CapsLock: CapsLock is the recognizable physical key label; preserving it lets players match the binding to their keyboard.
preservationReasons.Kana: Kana is the proper name of the Japanese input-mode key and is not translated in Czech.
preservationReasons.Kanji: Kanji is the proper name of the Japanese input-mode key and is not translated in Czech.
preservationReasons.End: End is the standard physical key label used on Czech keyboards.
preservationReasons.Home: Home is the standard physical key label used on Czech keyboards.
